# MoneyWeek features portfolio manager who says Burford has a "remarkable record"


January 28, 2025


-
-
-
-


*MoneyWeek* features Burford in an article entitled "How to find quality and profitability in financial companies." In the article, a portfolio manager says the following about Burford: "Through \[Burford's\] skillful due diligence, it has a remarkable record in backing successful cases."


[Read the full article here.](https://moneyweek.com/investments/share-tips/how-to-find-quality-and-profitability-in-financial-companies)
